An epic saga of men battling through five eras and five cities.

Tune-in to Xbox Presents: A Special Look at STRANGER THAN HEAVEN, a standalone broadcast featuring a full reveal of the brand-new title from Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio on May 6th at 4:00 pm PDT | May 7 at 12:00 am BST. 

Look forward to exciting details and an all-star cast from around the world.

STRANGER THAN HEAVEN is coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title and with Xbox Game Pass.

author: GameSpot
description:
Ground Zero is set to release on April 16th for PS5, Xbox series X/S, and Steam.

Fight through post-apocalyptic South Korea in this retro survival horror. Uncover the truth behind the devastating meteor impact that left the country in ruins and turned every living organism into a terrifying monstrosity. Fight. Solve puzzles. Upgrade gear. Make every bullet count.

Carve your own path. Akali joins the 2XKO roster starting April 7. Available on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5.

2XKO is a free-to-play fighting game from Riot Games, the studio behind VALORANT and League of Legends. Fight solo or with a friend in explosive 2v2 showdowns, mastering a range of powerful champion abilities and unique tag mechanics to take down the enemy duo.
